title: Zesty Uruguayan Beef Stew
description: A fatty, fluffy one-pot stew bursting with zesty flavors, sweet candy, and hearty beef stock cubes.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high until shimmering.
Add beef cubes and brown on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Stir in diced onion and minced garlic, cooking until onion softens, about 3 minutes.
Sprinkle in paprika and cumin, stir to coat meat and aromatics, about 30 seconds.
Pour in beef broth and dissolve the stock cubes, then stir in candy sugar.
Add sliced carrot, bay leaf, and season with salt to taste.
Bring mixture to a gentle boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 90 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Check for tenderness; the beef should be fork-tender and the sauce slightly thickened.
Remove the bay leaf, adjust seasoning, and let the stew rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Ladle stew into bowls, garnish with fresh parsley if desired, and enjoy a fluffy, zesty Uruguayan beef stew.
